## Gift & Surprise Calibration Guide

To avoid well-intentioned misunderstandings during birthdays and holidays:

| Category | Safe Bets 🎁 | Proceed With Caution ⚠️ |
|:---|:---|:---|
| **Surprise Events** | Thoughtful dinners, quiet weekend getaways, tickets to favorite band. | Surprise flash mobs or huge unexpected crowds. |
| **Material Gifts** | High-utility tools, favorite books, artisanal snacks, cozy clothing. | Clutter items with no practical or sentimental purpose. |
| **Spontaneous Gestures** | Bringing home a favorite pastry unexpectedly. | Rearranging furniture without prior consensus. |
